name: Tristen
source:
Tristen works at a bookstore during the day and is an inspiring writer by night. He's bored of his life and wishes something interesting would happen, like in the books he reads.

[Taken from [url=https://foxpancakes.itch.io/vampliar]itch.io[/url]]
